**Delhi NCR \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| 4–6 Years Experience**




 We are looking for a sharp, ambitious and highly dependable 
 **Senior Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations** 
  to establish and run the core HR operating systems of our Delhi NCR headquarters.
 



 This is a broad, hands\-on management mandate covering 
 **recruitment, payroll management, employee lifecycle, HR systems, international personnel administration, work\-authorisation coordination, performance processes, HR compliance, employee records and management reporting** 
 .
 



 The person joining us will not simply inherit an existing HR desk. They will help build a disciplined and scalable People Operations function capable of supporting a growing Indian and international workforce.
   





 The Senior Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations will be responsible for establishing and operating the 
 **Delhi HQ HR infrastructure** 
  and ensuring that employee administration is accurate, controlled, responsive and scalable.
 



 The role will include:
 


1. Establishing the core 
 **HR operating framework for the Delhi NCR headquarters** 
 , including HRIS, employee master data, personnel files, joining systems, attendance, leave, payroll controls, probation, performance\-cycle administration and separation processes.
2. Managing 
 **end\-to\-end payroll administration and payroll coordination** 
 , including monthly employee data, attendance and leave inputs, salary changes, approved deductions, reimbursements, variable\-pay inputs, new joiners, exits and payroll reconciliation.
3. Working with Finance, payroll vendors and management to ensure that payroll records reconcile with approved employment terms and employee master data.
4. Maintaining payroll calendars, change\-control records, salary/CTC documentation and payroll exception trackers.
5. Coordinating statutory and employee\-related payroll documentation with the appropriate Finance, Legal, payroll and professional advisers.
6. Managing end\-to\-end recruitment across multiple concurrent managerial, specialist, technical and administrative mandates.
7. Managing RPOs, recruitment agencies, LinkedIn, job portals, direct sourcing and referral channels.
8. Coordinating candidate assessment, interview scheduling, approvals, compensation discussions, offers and joining.
9. Managing BGV, references, pre\-employment documentation and controlled onboarding.
10. Creating and maintaining accurate employee records, organisation data, reporting relationships, designation/grade records and employment\-history documentation.
11. Managing attendance, leave, probation, confirmation, promotions, approved compensation changes, transfers and employee status changes.
12. Operationalising Board\- and management\-approved HR, workplace, travel, employee and administrative policies.
13. Maintaining policy acknowledgements, training evidence, compliance registers and HR audit documentation.
14. Supporting performance\-management administration, including 
 **30/60/90\-day reviews, probation reviews, confirmation documentation, performance records and management follow\-up** 
 .
15. Handling employee grievances, disciplinary documentation, difficult employee matters, resignations, handovers, separation processes and final\-clearance coordination.
16. Maintaining appropriate confidentiality and access controls for sensitive personnel and compensation data.
17. Coordinate 
 **international employee mobility** 
 , including visa/work\-authorisation, immigration, FRRO/FRO and renewal documentation through Legal/authorised advisers.
18. Maintain complete 
 **passport, visa, permit, registration and expiry controls** 
  for foreign personnel and international specialists.
19. Coordinate 
 **invitation letters, supporting documentation, relocation, accommodation and joining logistics** 
  for international employees.
20. Maintain an 
 **International Personnel \& Mobility Register** 
  covering status, expiries, pending actions and responsible owners.
21. Ensure required documentation and internal clearances are complete before international personnel commence regulated or approval\-dependent activities.
22. Support overseas deputation, travel and assignment documentation for Indian employees where required.
23. Establish and maintain the 
 **Delhi HQ HR operating system** 
 , including Employee Master, HRIS, recruitment pipeline, offers, BGV, joining, personnel files, attendance/leave and payroll controls.
24. Maintain 
 **compensation\-change, probation, confirmation, performance\-review, policy\-acknowledgement and training records** 
 .
25. Maintain 
 **grievance, disciplinary, separation, clearance, HR\-vendor and management\-MIS systems** 
 .
26. Own the 
 **HR\-side payroll process and reconciliation controls** 
  in coordination with Finance and authorised service providers.



  




 WHAT WE EXPECT IN THE FIRST 90 DAYS
 
 Within the first three months, the successful candidate should be able to demonstrate:
 


* a functioning Delhi HQ HR operating system;
* complete employee master and controlled personnel files;
* recruitment dashboard covering all approved vacancies;
* functioning HRIS or controlled interim HR database;
* reliable attendance and leave administration;
* documented monthly payroll process and reconciliation controls;
* BGV and onboarding tracker;
* probation and confirmation calendar;
* approved policy implementation and acknowledgement records;
* management HR dashboard;
* international personnel / visa / work\-authorisation tracker where applicable;
* HR vendor and recruiter controls;
* defined employee joining, lifecycle and separation workflows.


 THE PERSON WE WANT
 
 We are looking for somebody who can 
 **build systems and then operate them** 
 .
 



 A strong candidate will be equally comfortable interviewing a senior candidate in the morning, resolving a payroll discrepancy before lunch, checking the documentation of an international employee in the afternoon and preparing a concise management dashboard before the day ends.
 



 That breadth is intentional.
 



 The role suits an HR professional who wants genuine ownership and institutional\-building responsibility — not somebody looking for a narrowly defined recruitment, HRBP or employee\-engagement position.
 


 Particularly valuable experience
 
 Candidates who have previously helped establish a 
 **new corporate office, regional headquarters, business unit, plant, international office or rapidly expanding operation** 
  will be particularly relevant.
 



 Exposure to any combination of the following will be valuable:
 



***HRIS implementation • Payroll management • Multi\-agency recruitment • International employees • Employment visas / mobility administration • BGV • Employee lifecycle • HR compliance • Performance administration • Office mobilisation • Regulated or industrial environments***




 This addition makes the position substantially stronger. It now reads as the 
 **person responsible for establishing the Delhi HQ People Operations infrastructure** 
 , rather than simply a Senior HR recruitment manager.

title: Sr Manager, Integrated Security Operations
description:
The Senior Manager, GSS India\- provides leadership and governance for ISOC and its expanding JAPAC support mandate, while strengthening regional incident readiness and business resilience. The role integrates security operations center governance, intelligence\-led monitoring, Incident Management Team (IMT) preparedness, incident coordination, Business Continuity Planning (BCP), and continuous improvement into a coherent operating model.
   

  

 This is a senior, critical leadership role with accountability for outcomes, readiness, governance, and cross\-functional coordination. Day\-to\-day monitoring and control room execution remain with the ISOC operational leadership and analyst teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* ISOC Leadership \& Governance
* Provide end\-to\-end leadership and governance for ISOC performance, service delivery, operating procedures, service


 levels, escalation protocols, quality, and risk controls.
   

  

* Guide the evolution of ISOC as a scalable, intelligence\-driven regional hub supporting India and JAPAC.
* Ensure effective 24x7 monitoring, triage, notification, escalation, incident documentation, and employee assistance support.
* Establish meaningful performance indicators, trend analysis, assurance reviews, and leadership reporting.
* Drive process standardization, technology enablement, automation, workforce capability, and continuous improvement in


 partnership with GSS Technology and Systems.
   

  

* JAPAC Regional Support
* Lead the operational readiness and phased expansion of ISOC support for JAPAC, including service scope, coverage,


 handoffs, escalation pathways, and regional operating protocols.
   

  

* Work closely with the Regional Director, JAPAC, regional GSS leaders, and in\-country stakeholders to align ISOC support


 with regional priorities and global GSS standards.
   

  

* Promote consistent regional situational awareness, risk monitoring, incident visibility, and timely escalation across


 supported markets.
   

  

* Ensure ISOC regional support complements, and does not replace, local response ownership and country\-specific


 requirements.
   

  

* Incident Management Team Readiness \& Coordination
* Support the Regional GSS Lead in maintaining IMT readiness, governance, rosters, activation protocols, escalation criteria,


 and supporting documentation.
   

  

* Coordinate IMT preparedness activities, including periodic touchpoints, tabletop exercises, simulations, training, and


 lessons\-learned reviews.
   

  

* Enable effective incident coordination through timely situational awareness, action tracking, Emergency Notification System support, meeting records, and stakeholder updates.
* Support After\-Action Reviews and track corrective and preventive actions to closure.
* Maintain alignment among the regional IMT, local Emergency Response Teams (ERTs), the Corporate Crisis Management


 Team (CMT), GSOC, and ISOC.
   

  

* Business Continuity \& Operational Resilience
* Coordinate GSS India Business Continuity Planning requirements in alignment with 1\-Adobe Enterprise Resilience (1\-AER),


 enterprise BCP processes, and applicable Site Recovery Plans.
   

  

* Partner with business and functional stakeholders on Business Impact Analyses (BIAs), continuity plans, recovery priorities,


 and testing or assurance activities.
   

  

 Global Safety \& Security \| Job Description \| Confidential
   

  

* Connect BCP, incident management, emergency response, and site recovery arrangements to support a coordinated


 response and recovery model.
   

  

* Maintain current, controlled, and audit\-ready documentation, with clear ownership and remediation tracking.
* Identify resilience gaps, dependencies, and improvement opportunities and provide transparent reporting to leadership.
* Cross\-Functional Partnership
* Work as an integrated partner with India Security Operations, Security Systems \& Technology, and Environmental Health \&


 Safety / Safety leadership to ensure coordinated delivery across people, places, and technology.
   

  

* Partner with Site Operations and Safety teams during incidents, exercises, recovery activities, and operational readiness


 reviews.
   

  

* Build effective relationships with regional GSS leaders, Employee Experience, Employee Communications, Legal,


 Corporate Risk, Adobe Technology Services, Global Site Operations, Travel, and other subject matter experts.
   

  

* Clarify roles, decision rights, handoffs, and escalation paths across partner functions to prevent duplication and strengthen


 accountability.
   

  

* Governance, Reporting \& Improvement
* Prepare concise executive briefings, dashboards, decision papers, and incident or resilience updates for India and regional


 leadership.
   

  

* Maintain SOPs, playbooks, control documentation, action trackers, and governance rhythms for the role portfolio.
* Use operational data, incident trends, exercise findings, and stakeholder feedback to prioritize improvements and


 investment needs.
   

  

* Support budget planning, supplier governance, workforce planning, audit actions, and capability development relevant to


 ISOC and resilience.
   

  

 Key Working Relationships
   

  

* Internal: Director, India Safety \& Security; India Security Operations Lead; Security Systems \& Technology Lead;


 Environmental Health \& Safety / Safety Lead; ISOC operational leadership and analysts.
   

  

* Regional: Regional Director, JAPAC; country and regional GSS leaders; GSOC; relevant JAPAC stakeholders.
* Cross\-functional: Global Site Operations, Employee Experience, Employee Communications, Legal, Corporate Risk, Adobe


 Technology Services, Travel, Enterprise Resilience, and other IMT members.
   

  

* External: Service providers and suppliers supporting ISOC, risk monitoring, emergency notification, continuity, and


 specialist response capabilities.
   

  

**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience; professional certifications in security, incident


 management, emergency management, or business continuity are preferred.
   

  

* Progressive experience in security operations, security operations center leadership, incident or crisis management,


 business continuity, resilience, or a related discipline.
   

  

* Demonstrated experience leading or governing a SOC, GSOC, ISOC, or comparable 24x7 operational environment.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional incident response, exercises, After\-Action Reviews, and corrective action programs.
* Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, or time zones, preferably within JAPAC.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and governance capabilities.
* Credential such as CPP, CBCP, ISO 22301 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CEM, MBCI, ICS Certifications, will be an added


 advantge
   

  

 Core Capabilities
   

  

* Operational leadership and disciplined execution
* Incident command support and decision\-making under pressure
* Business continuity and operational resilience
* Intelligence\-led monitoring, risk assessment, and trend analysis
* Executive communication and stakeholder influence
* Cross\-functional collaboration without reliance on direct authority
* Process improvement, technology enablement, and change leadership
* High standards of integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and duty of care


 Measures of Success
   

  

* ISOC service reliability, escalation quality, response timeliness, and stakeholder confidence.
* Effective and sustainable expansion of ISOC support across JAPAC.
* IMT readiness demonstrated through current rosters, training, exercises, activation support, and action closure.


 Global Safety \& Security \| Job Description \| Confidential
   

  

* Improved alignment among ISOC, India Security Operations, Systems \& Technology, Safety, and regional GSS leadership.
* Current and tested continuity and recovery arrangements for in\-scope GSS functions and sites.
* Clear, timely, decision\-useful reporting on incidents, risk trends, readiness, and improvement priorities.
* Sustained closure of audit, exercise, incident, and resilience improvement actions.

**Responsibilities:**
* Delivers accurate, timely, and thorough responses to routine and non\-standard inquiries in written and verbal interactions with internal and external parties.
* Identifies and seizes servicing opportunities for both self and the team.
* Manages the onboarding process for new hires, actively participating in their learning journey and providing feedback on skill development.
* Establishes and communicates standards to the team by regularly monitoring weekly department metrics that uphold department KPIs.
* Evaluates personnel regularly to ensure efficiency in their roles, including reviewing employee anti\-patterns, goals, aspirations, strengths, and weaknesses, with input from the division lead.
* Collaborates with the division lead to identify and address performance improvement needs.
* Contributes to operational targets by participating in annual external calls under the guidance of the division lead.

* Fosters client success and employee development, seeking mentorship from the Division Lead as needed.
* Ensures quality service and operational performance align with client expectations and compliance standards.
* Participates in projects with upper management that align with company goals.

* Identifies opportunities for improvement within the department, communicates ideas with leadership, and actively works to implement change.

* Participates in cross\-departmental projects to implement procedures for large/major clients, ensuring client success and compliance through standard operating models.

* Being able to identify trends, develop new ideas, and make recommendations that will benefit the company.
* Being able to develop and implement change management plans, as well as communicate and manage change with team members and other stakeholders.
* Being able to develop and implement risk mitigation strategies.
* Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Excellent attention to detail and strong documentation skills.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Exceptional problem\-solving abilities.

* 9\+ years of relevant experience in leading a cross\-functional and collaborative team.

 International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors and entrepreneurs. * Contributes to area/ branch profitability
* Monitors and implements best practices across the region

**Pro\-tip :** 
 Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.

* Must have at least 2 end\-to\-end implementation experience and strong hands\-on experience in SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) module.
* Proficiency in S/4HANA Finance with a focus on Treasury, Cash, and Liquidity Management
* Experience in Cash Management, Bank Communication Management (BCM), and In\-House Cash (IHC)
* Good understanding of Credit Risk, financial instruments, and exposure management.
* Familiarity and Hands on experience with SAP FICO concepts, including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting.
* Knowledge of integration with FI, CO, MM, and external banking systems.

 **Blue Dart is where you belong** 
 . Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 The
 **Inbound Shift In\-charge** 
 is responsible for leading all inbound operations within the assigned Service Centre, ensuring timely receipt, unloading, scanning, sorting, reconciliation and processing of shipments while meeting Blue Dart's service commitments and operational standards.
   

  

 The role provides frontline leadership to Ops Staff, Senior Ops Staff, Territory Service Representatives (TSRs) and Senior Territory Service Representatives (Senior TSRs) deployed during the shift, ensuring optimum manpower utilization, operational discipline, shipment accuracy, productivity, safety and compliance. The incumbent plays a key role in ensuring smooth shift operations, maintaining operational governance and supporting seamless connectivity across Blue Dart's network.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To lead and manage inbound shift operations by ensuring timely and accurate receipt, processing and reconciliation of shipments, while driving operational productivity, service quality, workforce effectiveness, safety, compliance and adherence to Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
**Inbound Operations Management**
* Lead and supervise all inbound operational activities during the assigned shift.
* Ensure timely receipt, unloading and processing of inbound vehicles and shipments.
* Monitor shipment receiving, scanning, reconciliation, segregation and sorting activities.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments to subsequent operational stages in line with defined service commitments.
* Coordinate with outbound operations and network teams to ensure smooth operational flow.


**Shipment Processing \& Service Quality**

* Drive adherence to shipment processing timelines, operational SLAs and service commitments.
* Minimize shipment exceptions, mis\-sorts and operational delays through proactive monitoring.

**People Leadership \& Shift Management**

* Ensure compliance with statutory, regulatory and company requirements.


**Operational Governance \& Productivity**
* Monitor shift productivity and operational performance against defined targets.
* Review operational dashboards, reports and shift performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
* Ensure timely completion of operational documentation and accurate system updates.
* Conduct effective shift handovers, highlighting key operational issues and priorities.
* Escalate operational risks, service failures and resource constraints to the reporting manager in a timely manner.
* Support implementation of continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and service quality.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**

 EdTech, Education SaaS, Social Impact / Development Sector, or purpose\-led B2B/B2G organisations
   

  

* About iDream Education


**Vision:** 
 Unlimited Learning. Unlimited Growth. For Everyone.
   

  

**Belief:** 
 We believe that access to learning and growth is a fundamental right, and that learning in its truest sense is the joyful unfolding of a being's fullest potential — in all dimensions of life.
   

  

**Mission:** 
 To deliver solutions and experiences that facilitate access to learning and growth for everyone, irrespective of their languages, geographies, abilities, curricula, age groups, learning styles, and socio\-economic status.
   

  

**Education**
 iPrep by iDream Education is a Learning Platform that runs both offline \& online, is bilingual and works on all major hardware devices and operating systems. iPrep delivers curriculum\-aligned digital learning for classes 1st to 12th in English, Hindi, and Regional language mediums for universal reach and learning use as:
   

  

* iPrep Digital Class for Smart Classrooms
* iPrep Digital Library for Tablets/Notebooks based Smart ICT Labs
* iPrep PAL for Personalised Adaptive Learning
* iPrep Tablets for Preloaded Learning Devices with Monitoring
* iPrep App for a one\-stop learning platform across Android, iOS, and Web

 **Learn Unlimited** 
 .
   

  

 Company website:
 **www.idreameducation.org**
 iPrep website:
 **www.iprep.in**
* Role Summary


 We are looking for an IT Lead — someone who will be the single point of ownership for everything IT at iDream Education. This is not a narrow infrastructure or helpdesk role; it is a domain\-ownership role spanning internal systems, network and cloud infrastructure, our field\-deployed device fleet (iPrep Tablets and other hardware), data security, and compliance.
   

  

 You will be the person who ensures our internal teams never lose a working day to IT friction, and who ensures thousands of devices deployed across schools and NGOs in rural India stay secure, tracked, and functional. You will also be the one building the IT function itself — starting hands\-on, and growing it into a proper team as iDream scales.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities \& Deliverables


**IT Infrastructure, Systems \& Support**
* Own and manage all internal IT infrastructure — networks, servers, cloud services, and systems administration — ensuring uptime, reliability, and security across office operations.
* Run IT helpdesk and support for all employees, ensuring fast turnaround on hardware, software, and access\-related issues.
* Own vendor relationships for hardware, software licenses, ISPs, cloud providers, and AMC contracts — negotiating terms, managing renewals, and controlling IT spend.


**Device \& Field Hardware Fleet Management**
* Own the full lifecycle of iPrep Tablets and other field\-deployed hardware — procurement, provisioning, tracking, maintenance, and end\-of\-life — across schools and NGO locations.
* Build and maintain systems for remote monitoring, troubleshooting, and updates of devices deployed at scale in low\-connectivity environments.
* Coordinate with product and tech teams to ensure hardware compatibility with new iPrep software releases and rollouts.


**Data Security \& Compliance**
* Own information security practices across the organisation — access controls, data backup, endpoint security, and incident response.
* Ensure the organisation's data handling practices align with DPDPA 2023 and other applicable data protection requirements.
* Conduct periodic security audits and risk assessments, and build/maintain IT policies, SOPs, and documentation.


**AI\-First IT Operations:** 
 Bring AI\-augmented workflows into IT operations — from automated monitoring and alerting to AI\-assisted troubleshooting, documentation, and reporting — keeping iDream's IT stack modern and lean.
   

  

* Qualifications \& Experience


**Experience:** 
 5–7 years in IT infrastructure, systems administration, or IT operations, with demonstrable ownership across networks, hardware/device management, and security — ideally including experience managing hardware deployed outside a single office (field, retail, or distributed environments).
   

  

**Sector Context:** 
 Experience in EdTech, the Development sector, or mission\-driven B2B/B2G environments is a strong advantage. Experience managing device fleets in low\-bandwidth or rural contexts is a plus.
   

  

**Technical Proficiency:** 
 Strong grounding in networking, systems administration (Windows/Linux), cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), and device/MDM (mobile device management) tools.
   

  

**Security \& Compliance:** 
 Working knowledge of IT security fundamentals and data protection principles, including familiarity with DPDPA 2023\.
   

  

**Vendor \& Budget Management:** 
 Proven experience managing vendor contracts, AMC negotiations, and IT budgets.
   

  

**AI Fluency:** 
 You use AI tools as a daily productivity layer for monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and reporting — not as a novelty.
   

  

* Key Skills \& Competencies


**What Makes You a Great Fit?**
 You think in systems, not tickets. You've owned IT for an organisation before — not just responded to issues as they came in — and you know how to build infrastructure and processes that scale without breaking. You're equally comfortable troubleshooting a server issue and thinking through how thousands of tablets in rural India stay secure and functional. You're excited about using AI to make IT operations faster and leaner, and you've already started building that into how you work.
   

  

* What We're Looking For — Values \& Culture Fit
* Integrity: Takes ownership of IT infrastructure, security, compliance, and data protection with transparency, accountability, and strong ethical standards.
* Excellence: Builds reliable, secure, scalable, and AI\-enabled IT systems while continuously improving infrastructure, processes, and support.
* Collaboration: Works effectively with internal teams, vendors, and technology partners to ensure seamless IT operations and successful hardware and system deployments.
* Impact: Enables uninterrupted business operations and ensures secure, reliable technology reaches teams, schools, and last\-mile learners at scale.
* Why Join Us


 We are on a mission to take the best of digital learning to every corner of rural Bharat. At iDream, you will have the opportunity to build and own the IT function from the ground up — one that keeps our teams productive and our technology reaching the last\-mile learner securely and reliably.
   

  

* Required Skills (Portal Tags)


 Network Administration, Systems Administration, Cloud Infrastructure, IT Security, Device/MDM Management, Vendor Management, Data Protection Compliance, Decision Making, Analytical Skills

title: Senior Lead Analyst, Supplier Governance & Performance Management
description:
The Senior Lead Analyst, Supplier Governance \& Performance Management will play a key role in strengthening supplier accountability, service performance, and stakeholder capability across EDT. This role will actively manage supplier performance for a focused portfolio of large, strategic suppliers while enabling contract owners and functional stakeholders to more effectively manage supplier performance across the broader supplier base. The role will lead structured service reviews, monitor contractual commitments and service expectations, drive issue resolution and corrective actions, and partner with Supplier Management reporting and analytics roles to turn supplier performance insights into clear actions and measurable improvement.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Lead supplier performance management for an assigned portfolio of large, strategic EDT suppliers, including service review cadence, governance routines, performance expectations, SLA/KPI oversight, and continuous improvement follow\-up.
* Facilitate structured supplier performance reviews with suppliers, contract owners, EDT towers, and functional stakeholders to evaluate service delivery, contractual commitments, risks, issues, and progress against agreed action plans.
* Monitor supplier performance against agreed service levels, obligations, commitments, and operational expectations; identify performance gaps, trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Drive issue and corrective action management by documenting performance concerns, clarifying ownership, tracking actions to closure, and escalating unresolved or systemic issues through defined governance channels.
* Partner with Supplier Management reporting and analytics roles to use supplier scorecards, dashboards, service level reporting, and performance insights to inform reviews, decisions, escalations, and improvement plans.
* Enable stakeholders managing suppliers outside the assigned strategic portfolio by providing guidance, templates, playbooks, coaching, and standard practices for supplier reviews, KPI interpretation, issue management, escalation, and corrective action follow\-through.
* Support contract owners and stakeholders in understanding supplier obligations, performance expectations, governance roles, and escalation paths, while reinforcing accountability across Stryker and supplier teams.
* Contribute to the continued maturity of the Supplier Management function by improving performance management standards, stakeholder enablement materials, governance routines, and supplier performance management processes.


**What you need:**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business administration, Data Analytics or related discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
* 10\-12 years of experience in supplier/vendor management, service governance, IT service management, sourcing, procurement, or related disciplines, with a strong track record of managing strategic supplier relationships.
* Proven experience partnering directly with large\-scale or technology service providers to drive performance, accountability, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of supplier governance frameworks, service level management, KPIs, SLAs, contractual obligations, and corrective action planning.
* Demonstrated ability to lead supplier performance reviews, governance forums, issue resolution processes, and escalation management activities.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret scorecards, dashboards, and performance metrics, conduct root cause analysis, and translate insights into measurable actions.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to coach, facilitate, and drive alignment across suppliers, contract owners, and cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* Executive\-level communication and presentation skills, including the ability to synthesize complex performance issues, risks, and recommendations into clear, actionable narratives for leadership audiences.
* Strong diplomacy, conflict resolution, and relationship management capabilities, with a focus on fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous service improvement.


 Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

Monitoring and up\-gradation of various processes to improve the performance in terms of RMC, productivity \& waste generation etc.

* Monitor troubleshooting activities in the site \& find out root causes
* Improvement plan based on gap analysis between R\&D target and actual performance.
* Detailed planning for project implementation to minimise time in product launching
* Plan for identification of various cost reduction activities based on plant performance
* Verifications and audit of P\&I Ds’ and equipment installations to fulfil the desired safety standard
* Monitor resolution of troubleshooting activities in liaison with other departments involved depending upon the nature of issue
* Drive reduction of operational cost reduction projects by proper allocation of resources to existing products
* Support the preparation of necessary documents like SOP, LOGSHEET, BFD, BOM, Critical process parameter etc. before the startup of new products


****Operational Responsibilities****
* Serve as the preliminary contact point on the site for any deviation in quality, safety, yield, cycle time etc. and should coordinate with Process Technology, Technology Transfer, EHS and Operations teams to understand the root cause of the deviation
* Work with Lead Technical Services (Site) to provide assistance for all troubleshooting activities
* Analysis of different parameters for process improvements.
* Thorough understanding \& knowledge of Chemical unit processes such as Chlorination, bromination, reduction \& hydrogenation, nitration, sulphonation, esterification, Amination \& ammonolysis, methylation, oxidation, cyclization, condensation etc.
* Thorough understanding \& knowledge about unit operations such as fluid mechanics, agitation \& mixing of liquids, absorption\-desorption, adsorption, distillation, liquid –liquid extractions, humidification\- dehumidification, crystallization, filtration, drying etc.
* Scale up procedures \& scale up of lab scale experiments to Kilo Lab \& Pilot plant and subsequently to commercial production in stipulated time frame taking into considerations the economics \& safety.
* Establishing standard yield and desired quality at all stages of development of molecules.
* Complete knowledge of basic engineering (design of chemical equipment such as agitators, reactors, crysatllizers, filters, dryers, fractionation columns, heat transfer equipment, absorption\& desorption systems etc; line sizing, equipment selection, finalization of instrumentation philosophy, writing DCS logics, mass balance, energy balance, development of conceptual plant layout, Preparation of equipment data sheets, Preparation of instruments data sheet, Development of PFD’s \& P\&ID’s, MOC selection, HAZOP study, Preparing SOP’s \& Log sheets, estimation of utility requirements etc)
* Well versed in co\-ordination with BD, R\&D, Technology Transfer, Projects, Engg., Production \& QC.
* Trouble shoot the process during commissioning as well as during product life cycle management to ensure planned productivity, standard yield and desired quality throughout the year
* Thorough understanding and knowledge about energy saving \& waste reduction as well as yields improvement drive for sustainability as well as to be competitive in the market. In other words, to be well versed (procedures \& Processes) with products life cycle management exercise.
* Provide guidance to site development chemist for conducting various lab studies
* Timely release of SOP and other documents for existing products in new facility.
* Resolve issues related to quality, yield and productivity during monitoring of batches


****Financial Responsibilities****
* Support the process of cost optimization for existing products
* Ensure achievement of cost saving initiatives to achieve targeted savings in time frame


****People Responsibilities****
* Drive initiatives for training need identification and building requisite skills \& competencies through systematic training \& skill\-upgradation initiatives for the team

* Set goals and review performance for sub\-ordinates
* Inspire \& motivate employees through demonstrated commitment to PI’s values, vision \& active participation in engagement activities
* Develop and maintain a culture of continuous improvement within the team


****Education Qualification****
 B.E/B.Tech in Chemical Engineering
   

  

****Work Experience****
 5\-10 years of experience in managing operations support, root cause analysis
   

  

****Industry to be Hired from****
 Agro\-API\-Fine\-Chemicals

* Basic understanding of process design, scale up and implementation of new products on commercial plant.

title: Sourcing Executive
description:
Sourcing Executive is responsible for managing the end\-to\-end sourcing process for apparel products, including but not limited to fabrics, trims, and finished garments. OTIF is the primary KRA for this role along with identifying and developing supplier relationships, negotiating contracts, ensuring quality standards, and optimizing costs to meet the company's apparel production needs. The Sourcing Manager plays a critical role in maintaining the quality and profitability of our apparel business.
 



 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Supplier Management:



 o Identify, evaluate, and establish relationships with suppliers who can meet the company's quality, cost, and capacity requirements.
 



 o Develop and maintain strong partnerships with existing suppliers to ensure reliability and consistent product quality.
 



 o Monitor supplier performance, conduct regular audits, and address any issues or non\-compliance.
 


* OTIF Management :



 o On time in fulfilment – Primary KRA for this role. Ensuring to launch all products on the launch date in fulfilment. This will involve capacity planning and production planning with suppliers along with ensuring all levers for timely inspection are in place.
 



 o To conduct the annual review of supplier performance with QA.
 



 o To pursue and recover all money due from vendors as a result of performance penalties or markdown and promotional contributions.
 



 o Ensures timely delivery of samples by vendors where the product can go through a first\-time right approval.
 


* Cost Optimization:



 o Negotiate pricing and terms with suppliers to achieve cost savings while maintaining product quality.
 



 o Analyze market trends and work with suppliers to identify opportunities for cost reduction and value enhancement.
 



 o Continuously review and optimize the supply chain to improve cost\-efficiency.
 



 Quality Control:
 



 o Set and maintain strict quality standards for all apparel products.
 



 o Work closely with suppliers to ensure that products meet quality specifications and conduct inspections when necessary.
 



 o Develop and implement quality improvement initiatives in collaboration with suppliers.
 


* Procurement Strategy:



 o Develop and execute a strategic sourcing plan for the apparel business in alignment with overall company goals.
 



 o Monitor market dynamics and global trends to make informed decisions about sourcing locations and strategies.
 



 o Manage lead times, inventory levels, and order quantities to meet demand.
 


* Risk Management:



 o Identify potential risks in the supply chain and develop contingency plans to mitigate disruptions.
 



 o Stay updated on global trade regulations and compliance requirements for the apparel industry.
 



 o Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to ensure adherence to international standards.
 


* Vendor Contracts and Agreements:



 o Negotiate, draft, and manage contracts and agreements with suppliers.
 



 o Ensure that all terms and conditions are favorable to the company's interests and compliant with legal and ethical standards.
 



 ·

 · Bachelor's degree in Garment management, Business Administration, or a related field.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AIA - Mainframe - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced Manager – Mainframe Modernization to lead our AI\-Driven Legacy Transformation practice. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise across mainframe ecosystems, AI/ML\-driven modernization strategies, and cloud technologies, combined with strong leadership, stakeholder management, and team\-building capabilities to deliver large\-scale digital transformation programmes.
   

  

 You will own the end\-to\-end modernization strategy, drive cross\-functional collaboration with C\-suite leaders, business stakeholders, and architecture teams, and lead a team of engineers and specialists to successfully migrate mission\-critical mainframe workloads to modern, scalable, cloud\-native platforms using AI\-powered automation frameworks.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence:**
* Strategic Leadership and Stakeholder Management
+ Define and own the mainframe modernization strategy aligned with business objectives and enterprise technology roadmaps.
+ Collaborate with senior stakeholders, business leaders, and architecture teams to prioritise modernization initiatives and secure executive buy\-in.
+ Evaluate and recommend modernization paths — rehosting, refactoring, rebuilding, or replacing — based on cost\-benefit analysis, risk assessment, and business impact.

* Mainframe Systems Assessment and Governance
+ Oversee comprehensive assessments of mainframe applications (COBOL, JCL, VSAM, DB2, CICS, IMS, Assembler) to identify modernization opportunities, risks, and dependencies.
+ Establish governance frameworks, quality gates, and standards for modernization delivery across the portfolio.
+ Drive technical debt identification, quantification, and systematic reduction across the legacy estate.

* AI\-Driven Modernization and Automation
+ Champion the adoption of AI tools, LLMs, and custom AI agentic workflows for automated code analysis, refactoring, and code translation at scale.
+ Define and operationalise AI pipelines, prompt engineering standards, and context engineering best practices to maximise modernization throughput and accuracy.
+ Evaluate emerging AI/ML technologies and integrate them into the modernization toolchain to maintain competitive advantage.

* Team Leadership and Capability Building
+ Lead, mentor, and grow a team of mainframe modernization engineers, developers, and analysts.
+ Build team capabilities in AI\-driven modernization, cloud\-native development, and DevOps practices.
+ Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and provide technical guidance to ensure delivery excellence.

* Target\-State Architecture – APIs and Microservices
+ Architect and oversee the design of target\-state systems, including API integrations, microservices, and event\-driven architectures.
+ Ensure modernized solutions are scalable, resilient, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.

* Cloud and Platform Integration
+ Lead the migration of mainframe workloads to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) using AI\-driven and automated solutions.
+ Ensure seamless integration of legacy systems with cloud\-native services, containerised deployments (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
+ Drive adoption of infrastructure\-as\-code, observability, and security best practices for modernized workloads.

* Reporting, Documentation, and Business Impact
+ Create and present executive\-level reporting on modernization progress, business impact, risks, and ROI.
+ Maintain comprehensive technical documentation including system designs, AI pipeline architectures, and modernization roadmaps.
+ Track and communicate KPIs related to migration velocity, quality, cost savings, and operational efficiency.


**Skills and Attributes:**
* Educational Background
* Bachelor / master’s degree in computer science, AI, Any Engineering or quantitative background preferred.


**Professional Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience with legacy mainframe systems (COBOL, JCL, Assembler, CICS, DB2, IMS, VSAM) with at least 3–4 years in a leadership or managerial capacity.
* Proven track record of leading large\-scale mainframe modernization or digital transformation programmes.
* Deep expertise in data migration, integration, ETL, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
* Strong proficiency in programming/scripting languages (Python, Java, etc.).
* Expert\-level knowledge of APIs, microservices architecture, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Extensive experience with AI tools, LLM API calls, prompt engineering, and context engineering for automating code analysis and modernization workflows.
* Experience with enterprise modernization platforms (Micro Focus, AWS Mainframe Modernization, Azure Migrate, Google Cloud Dual Run) is a plus.
* Hands\-on experience building or managing AI/ML pipelines for code transformation at scale.


**Soft Skills**
* Exceptional client engagement and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into practical, high\-quality technical solutions.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership abilities.
* Experience with Agile/SAFe delivery methodologies and managing distributed/global teams.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Cloud certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP), AI/ML certifications, enterprise architecture (TOGAF), or mainframe\-related certifications are a plus.


**Why Join Us**
* Be at the forefront of AI\-driven mainframe modernization across enterprise clients.
* Work with global clients to drive real business impact through large\-scale digital transformation.
* Collaborate with a team of modernization experts, AI specialists, and industry leaders in a highly innovative and entrepreneurial environment.


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, serving our clients locally and globally with innovation and at scale.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: VP, IAM Assurance Leader (L13)
description:
**Role Title: VP, IAM Assurance Leader (L13\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.
   

  

* We have recently been ranked \#2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid\-Sized Companies, ranked \#3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top\-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best\-in\-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work\-life integration and overall well\-being.
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities for all to take up leadership roles.


**Organizational Overview**
 The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony oversees key security functions including authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This team ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will oversee a team of seven and be a direct report into the VP, IAM Programs Leader.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 We are seeking an innovative and results\-driven leader to serve as VP, IAM Assurance Leader, responsible for leading the IAM Services Assurance function overseeing key controls across all centralized and decentralized IAM services. This role will work closely with IAM product owners and engineering teams to ensure adherence to Synchrony IAM standards and regulatory requirements without disrupting operational delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise and hands\-on experience across IAM controls, assurance operations, and identity/authentication platforms (e.g., Active Directory, LDAP technologies, Beyond Identity, and related IAM services). As a strategic leader, you will guide teams, enable cross\-functional collaboration, and drive continuous improvement in the effectiveness, reporting, and automation of IAM controls—particularly in critical areas such as logical access, authentication assurance, privileged access oversight, and control evidence for SOX/PCI and other regulatory obligations. You will blend technology insight with program management discipline to ensure success in execution and delivery, including the creation and modernization of assurance reporting capabilities and the automation of control remediation where appropriate.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Create and Maintain Strategic Roadmaps: Develop and execute multi\-year roadmaps to drive innovation, strengthen security posture, meet regulatory requirements, and streamline IAM operations—specifically for IAM assurance capabilities, control monitoring, and evidence automation.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build and nurture strong relationships across Security Operations, Technology Teams, Governance, Operational Risk, and Internal Audit, ensuring program alignment, audit readiness, and the ability to clearly demonstrate IAM control effectiveness to stakeholders and regulators.
* Risk and Progress Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and organizational risks while regularly reporting blockers, corrective actions, and program milestones to executive leadership; ensure timely remediation of control gaps and recurring defects.
* Solution Design \& Automation: Lead and contribute to designing technical solutions for complex automation use cases, driving operational efficiency and scalability—especially automation to detect, track, and remediate IAM control defects.
* Program Integrity: Ensure standards, policies, and procedures are accurately documented and officially maintained for audit and compliance requirements; recommend updates to IAM standards based on security threats, regulatory expectations, and industry trends.
* Performance Tracking: Define, implement, and monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure program maturity and overall effectiveness, including assurance coverage, control pass rates, remediation SLAs, defect recurrence, and reporting timeliness/accuracy.
* Assurance Operations Leadership: Lead assurance activities to track, validate, and remediate key logical access and authentication controls across centralized IAM services (e.g., Active Directory, Oracle LDAP, Beyond Identity) and decentralized implementations as applicable.
* Assurance Reporting Platform Ownership: Manage and evolve the IAM assurance reporting platform(s) used to monitor adherence to Synchrony standards, control design, and operational effectiveness; ensure reporting is accurate, resilient, and audit\-ready.
* Agile Partnership with Product Owners: Partner with IAM product owners and delivery teams using Agile methodologies to prioritize and implement control improvements, balancing risk reduction with service stability and customer impact.
* Control Evidence \& Audit Support: Ensure the organization can efficiently produce high\-quality evidence for SOX, PCI, and other examinations; proactively address audit issues with root\-cause correction and sustainable control improvements.
* Documentation \& Enablement: Oversee creation, maintenance, and review of operational process documentation and end\-user/training materials needed to support consistent execution of IAM assurance activities.
* Problem Resolution: Independently resolve technical challenges while escalating issues with clarity when necessary.
* Perform other critical duties or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* BS/BA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business Management, or equivalent, plus 10\+ years IT experience, OR in lieu of a degree with 12\+ years IT experience demonstrating progressive responsibility.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading multiple IAM service products (e.g., authentication, privileged access, identity governance) and driving outcomes across both centralized and distributed service models.
* Minimum 5 years of experience developing and improving IAM service processes and reporting on IAM service key controls (design and operating effectiveness).
* Minimum 3 years leading operations or assurance teams, including continuous monitoring, issue management, and control remediation.
* At least 2 years working with Agile methodologies in roles such as Product Owner, Scrum Master, or Technical Lead.
* Minimum 2 years of people management experience, leading teams of 2\+ engineers or contractors.


**Technical Expertise**
* Strong understanding of IAM directory services, such as Active Directory, LDAP, Oracle LDAP, or similar.
* Experience with assurance reporting, control monitoring dashboards, and/or metrics platforms used to track compliance and remediation status.
* Hands\-on experience with Security Control Design and Security Assurance Operations, including defining controls, validating operating effectiveness, and driving remediation.
* Hands\-on experience with Unix/Linux Server Access Administration and access security.
* Experience supporting or integrating IAM platforms and processes such as ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, privileged access tooling (e.g., Bomgar/BeyondTrust), and authentication technologies (e.g., RSA Authentication Manager or equivalents).


**Skills**
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for effective cross\-team collaboration and executive reporting, including the ability to translate technical risk into business impact.
* Strategic thinker able to develop and articulate long\-term program visions and actionable roadmaps.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, capable of managing multiple concurrent projects in complex environments.
* Proactive problem solver with the ability to navigate ambiguity and escalate appropriately.
* Strong analytical and clear\-thinking skills; ability to interpret control results, identify root causes, and drive durable corrective actions.
* Customer\-oriented mindset and ability to reduce friction for product teams while improving assurance outcomes.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Proven experience leading large\-scale IAM initiatives, including program design, execution, and cross\-functional collaboration in complex technical environments.
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, with a track record of creating and executing long\-term strategic roadmaps.
* Strong ability to manage risk and complexity, navigate roadblocks, and drive corrective actions effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage teams while building partnerships across business units and fostering alignment to organizational goals.
* Strong commitment to providing outstanding customer experiences; ability to balance control compliance with minimal operational disruption.
* Self\-starter with a strong sense of urgency and flexibility to change directions quickly while maintaining delivery discipline.
* Experience with the process of creating, maintaining and reviewing operations process \& end user training documentation.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, SailPoint IdentityIQ, Active Directory, Bomgar/BeyondTrust privileged access, Unix LDAP, and RSA Authentication Manager (or comparable tools).
* Experience working in highly regulated industries (Finance, Healthcare, Government), particularly enterprise\-level security in a financial institution.
* Familiarity with compliance standards such as SOX, PCI, FFIEC, GDPR, HIPAA, or NIST cybersecurity frameworks, including NIST 800\-63 and logical access control expectations.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, or relevant IAM\-focused certifications.

* Ability to manage L1 and L2 procurement helpdesk queries, coordinate with Bid Desk, Finance, Source\-to\-Pay, and category teams, and escalate critical issues appropriately.

* Experience supporting procurement transformation, channel management, tail spend reduction, and unmanaged spend compliance initiatives.
* Working knowledge of Coupa–Oracle integration touchpoints, including supplier site, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt\-related issue resolution.
* Comfort using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, dashboards, and reporting tools to monitor operational KPIs and support decision\-making.
* Awareness of AI\-enabled procurement capabilities, including Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio, Process Transformation with willingness to develop practical use cases and assist in Process Intelligence initiatives.

To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. title: Senior Finance Business Partner
description:
**Job Description**
 Titel: Senior Finance Business Partner
   

  

 Location: Bangalore
   

  

 Shift timing: 11:00AM – 8:00PM IST
   

  

 Experience: 8 – 13 Years
   

  

 Introduction to the job
   

  

 Act as the primary financial business partner to the Technology function, owning the full budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis cycle for a \~$35M Non\-Employee IT expense base supporting 400\+ employees. This role goes beyond data consolidation: it requires proactively engaging Technology leadership in business discussions, independently translating those discussions into financial numbers, and delivering decision\-quality insight, dashboards and follow\-through on actions — reducing the need for Director\-level involvement in day\-to\-day business partnering.
   

  

**Some of the things you’ll be doing**
* Business Partnering \& Stakeholder Engagement
* Act as the first point of contact for Technology leadership on all financial matters, independently engaging in business discussions.
* Proactively ask the right questions of Technology, Procurement and Vendor Management stakeholders to understand cost drivers, new initiatives, vendor contracts and renewal terms ahead of time.
* Build strong, trust\-based relationships across the Technology organization to gain early visibility into spend decisions and changes.
* Budgeting \& Forecasting
* Own end\-to\-end Non\-EE budgeting and forecasting for the $35M Technology cost base across all managed ERPs.
* Download, consolidate and reconcile transaction\-level data from NetSuite, SAP, Tally and other regional ERPs, mapping consistently to EPM cost categories.
* Partner with Technology leaders to validate assumptions, vendor renewals, contract changes and new project spend ahead of each budget/forecast cycle.
* Variance Analysis \& Commentary
* Deliver high\-quality, insight\-led variance commentary (Actuals vs Budget/Forecast) that clearly explains root causes and business drivers rather than restating numbers.
* Prepare a “no\-surprises” analysis ahead of monthly/quarterly reviews, anticipating leadership questions.
* Reporting \& Dashboards
* Maintain and continuously improve the Power BI Technology dashboard (Non\-EE, EE and headcount views), ensuring accuracy and timely refresh.
* Enable self\-service reporting for Technology and Finance stakeholders.
* Action Tracking \& Follow\-Through
* Maintain a structured action/issue tracker for open items with Procurement, Finops and BU stakeholders, ensuring clear ownership, due dates and closure.
* Drive items through to measurable resolution rather than repeated status\-only follow\-ups; escalate stalled items proactively.
* Governance \& Controls
* Ensure accurate cost centre, project and vendor cost allocation across Business Units.
* Support audit and compliance requirements relating to Technology spend and cost recharges.
* Process Leadership \& Automation
* Identify and drive automation opportunities to reduce manual, multi\-ERP consolidation effort (e.g., Power Query/Power Automate).
* Guide and review the work of any junior finance resources supporting Technology reporting.


**What technical skills, experience, and qualifications do you need?**
* Qualified accountant, MBA (Finance), or equivalent senior finance qualification, with 8\+ years of overall finance experience including 3\+ years in a Finance Business Partnering / FP\&A role.
* Proven experience managing a large, multi\-million\-dollar Technology/IT cost base, including SAAS, licensing and vendor spend.
* Practical, hands\-on experience with multiple ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP, Tally or similar), including consolidation of data from disparate systems.
* Advanced Excel and Power BI skills; experience with Oracle EPM or similar planning/consolidation tools is preferred.
* Prior experience supporting or partnering with a Technology/IT organization is highly preferred.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to independently engage Technology leaders, ask probing questions, and translate discussions into financial plans without close supervision.
* Excellent variance analysis and financial storytelling skills, producing clear, insight\-driven commentary suited to senior leadership audiences.
* Strong sense of ownership and follow\-through, driving actions to closure and measurable outcomes rather than status updates alone.
* Ability to manage multiple ERP data sources, consolidating and reconciling large transaction volumes efficiently and accurately.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills across finance and non\-finance audiences.
* A process\-improvement and automation mindset, with the ability to simplify and streamline recurring reporting tasks.


 Key Competencies
   

  

* Commercial and analytical thinking
* Ownership, follow\-through and cross\-functional coordination
* Constructive challenge and clear stakeholder communication
* Root\-cause analysis and structured problem\-solving
* Ability to convert detailed data into focused management actions
* Agility and adaptability in a fast\-changing technology cost environment


**Responsibilities**
* Own the full budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis cycle for the Technology function's \~35M Non\-Employee IT expense base.
* Proactively engage with Technology leadership, understanding their business needs and translating them into financial insights.
* Develop and deliver decision\-quality dashboards and reports, providing actionable financial intelligence to stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Procurement, Vendor Management, and FinOps teams to optimize expense management and contract negotiations.
* Partner with Corporate FP\&A and BU Controllers to ensure alignment and consistency in financial planning and reporting.
* Conduct in\-depth financial analysis and provide recommendations to support Technology's strategic initiatives and investment decisions.
* Monitor and analyze financial performance, identifying trends and variances, and proposing corrective actions when needed.
* Ensure compliance with financial policies and procedures, maintaining accurate records and documentation.
* Support the Director of Finance in special projects and ad\-hoc financial analyses as required.
* Stay updated on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies to enhance financial strategies and processes.

title: Sr Analyst Accounting & Financial Reporting
description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well\-being, and work\-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.
   

  

 Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.
   

  

 An exciting opportunity to be a member of the Finance \& Accounting with responsibility for accounting, tax and financial reporting within the Empower. Responsibilities include formulating balance sheets, income statements and cash flow statements that are subject to independent audit for the consolidated Company and its subsidiaries, and related supporting documents (financial statement tie\-outs) and certain functions related to the month\-end close process, including account reconciliations. In addition, responsibilities also include monthly reporting, reporting to regulatory bodies (foreign and domestic) and monitoring minimum regulatory capital requirements for certain subsidiaries. The senior analyst will also assist accounting on a monthly basis to prepare internal management reporting packages, including the supporting documents. Additionally, the role will assist with booking various monthly entries including cash and prepaids. The role includes interaction with other members of Corporate Accounting, Corporate Finance, Tax. Legal and Compliance, and Operations. In addition, the role will assist the Managers and Controller in various projects received from the CFO and the business units. This is a detailoriented position with stringent time deadlines, where time management, the ability to prioritize and multi\-task is essential.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and supporting analyses for the consolidated company and its subsidiaries, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.
* Prepare financial statement tie\-outs, workpapers, variance analysis, and other supporting documentation for accounting, financial reporting, regulatory reporting, audit, and other reporting deliverables.
* Perform account reconciliations and analyze unusual or significant account fluctuations; research and document explanations for variances and resolve identified discrepancies.
* Identify financial and regulatory reporting issues, unusual transactions, data inconsistencies, and reconciliation differences; research and escalate matters requiring management attention.
* Prepare monthly internal management reporting packages and analyses highlighting financial results and significant variances.
* Calculate and monitor regulatory capital requirements for applicable subsidiary companies and prepare required regulatory reporting and filings to domestic and foreign regulatory agencies, including related reconciliations and supporting documentation.
* Prepare and file applicable Bureau of Economic Analysis surveys.
* Support annual and interim external audits by preparing documentation and responding to information requests.
* Assist with tax\-related analyses, reporting requirements, and special projects.
* Partner with Corporate Accounting, Corporate Finance, Tax, Legal, Compliance, Operations, business units, and other stakeholders to complete financial reporting and project requirements.
* Support Managers, the Controller, and CFO with special projects and ad hoc financial analyses.


**What You Will Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or an equivalent field.
* Minimum 3 years of accounting, financial reporting, regulatory reporting, or related experience
* Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, STAT, and IFRS accounting bases.
* Ability to research accounting or regulatory codification and determine appropriate accounting treatment for new or non\-routine transactions.
* Ability to analyze financial data, investigate variances and reconciliation differences, and identify and escalate financial or regulatory reporting issues.
* Advanced or strong Microsoft Excel skills. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Experience using SAP. Experience using SAP or a comparable ERP system; SAP experience preferred.
* Strong understanding of financial reporting controls, reconciliations, and supporting documentation requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet stringent monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with multiple levels of management.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a team.


**What Will Set You Apart**
* Financial services industry experience.
* Experience preparing audited financial statements and supporting external audit requests.
* Experience with regulatory capital calculations and regulatory financial reporting.
* Experience supporting accounting or tax matters for multiple legal entities or subsidiaries.


 We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic FSO team!
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The Structured Finance Team specializes in addressing varying needs of market participants in the securitization marketplace across asset classes, including asset\- backed securities (ABS), commercial mortgage\- backed securities (CMBS), residential mortgage\- backed securities (RMBS) and collateralized loan obligations (CLO). The securitization market is a dynamic marketplace, continuously evolving with new regulations and technological advances every day. This a great opportunity to work in this fast\-paced transaction business, support diverse engagement teams, work with a wide variety of clients and lead business development activities on strategic and global priority accounts.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 The primary role of the SFT transaction team is to perform agreed\-upon procedures (AUP) to help clients execute securitization transactions successfully.
   

  

* Checking the accuracy of our financial models by comparing calculations to the governing documents
* Creating cashflow/analytics models for securitized products, including but not limited to CDOs/CLOs (Collateralized Debt Obligations/Collateralized Loan Obligations)
* Transaction modeling and analytics, which involves cash flow modeling, recalculating certain collateral quality and concentration limitations set out in each transaction’s indenture, including bond principal and interest payments, credit\-enhancement, hedging instruments, fees and waterfalls for structured deals
* Construct independent cash flow and collateral models for various structured products utilizing Microsoft Excel
* Create and update detailed agreed upon procedure reports summarizing our results

* 
* Perform various analyses on complex excel and third party models (Like Bloomberg, various Rating Agency Portal, Markit etc) for the valuation of Structured Products
* Establish relationships with client personnel at appropriate levels. Consistently deliver quality client services. Monitor progress, manage risk and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes
* Demonstrate in\-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Remain current on new developments in advisory services capabilities and industry knowledge.

 Strong leadership, teaming, technical and relationship\- building skills and integrity. **To qualify for the role, you must have**
* A Post\-graduation in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline and approximately 2 years of related work experience.
* Excellent prioritization skills and a commitment to meeting client deadlines
* Strong communication skills for report writing, client presentations and client interactions
* Proficient skills with MS Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
* Flexibility and willingness to work more than standard hours when necessary to meet client deadlines
* Willingness to work in shift based on the role hired for


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Prior structured finance experience


**What We Look For**
* Individuals who demonstrate in\-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge
* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail \& accuracy
* Ability to quickly assimilate to new knowledge and possess good business acumen
* Polished verbal and written communication skills in English


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
