title: Team Lead - Equity Index Data Management
description:
**Team Lead \- Equity Index Data — Job Description**
 Team Overview — Benchmarks \& Indices Operations
   

  

 Equity Index Data Management (EIDM) is part of the Benchmarks \& Indices Operations. We are a client\-focused, technology\-enabled team producing high\-value index data for internal and external clients. EIDM owns the underlying reference data used in the calculation of equity index products globally. We maintain LSEG intellectual property by generating and maintaining: ICB Classifications, Free Float, Voting Rights, Nationality, Universe preparation, Liquidity, and similar data points for Index Review, Rebalance, and Reconstitution cycles.
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

 The Team Lead \- Equity Index Data supervises the regional Bangalore team, owns global workflows, review deliverables and leads review planning with Index Review and Index Management. The role owns the performance metrics developed by Performance Enablement, supports the Manager in driving operational excellence and cross\-regional collaboration, and ensures quality and on\-time delivery across quarterly reviews, rebalances, and reconstitutions. The Team Lead will lead key initiatives, mentor team members, and contribute to product innovation, client engagement, vendor management, and automation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Team Leadership \& Supervision: Supervise and mentor the regional Bangalore team to ensure consistent delivery and adherence to FTSE Russell standards; provide coaching, feedback, and development support.
* Global Workflow Ownership: Own end\-to\-end global workflows (daily BAU, exception management process, quarterly and semi\-annual reviews and other production checkpoints), ensuring operational continuity, data integrity, and cross\-regional coordination.
* Review Planning: Lead review planning with Index Review and Index Management for quarterly reviews, rebalances, and reconstitutions, aligning schedules, dependencies, and quality gates.
* Performance Metrics Ownership: Own the performance matrix/metrics developed by Performance Enablement; monitor, report, and drive continuous improvements in efficiency, quality, and SLA adherence.
* Index Data Operations: Lead daily operations for index data validation, updates, and maintenance across global indices; uphold policy and ground rules compliance and delivery SLAs.
* Core Attribute Research \& Validation: Own research and validation of core index attributes including Free Float, Voting Rights, NICB/ICB classifications, and Country Classification.
* Timely Dataset Updates: Ensure timely and accurate updates to index dataset during review cycles, incorporating corporate actions and market events.
* Data Infrastructure: Maintain SQL databases, validation scripts, and reporting tools that support global index data workflows.

description:
**Job Title:\- Manager \- Strategic Buyer (L09\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 This role is in the Procurement within Source to Pay (S2P) organization in Synchrony. Source to Pay team provides centralized supplier procurement, contracting, \& ongoing management support across all Synchrony Functions delivering those products and services needed to be successful in our daily operations.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The Strategic Buyer plays a critical role in Synchrony’s procurement transformation by owning end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories within the Global Procurement Buy Desk and Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) function. The role ensures purchases are routed through the optimal buying channel—including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and guided buying through Coupa Smart Intake—while driving compliant purchasing, PO lifecycle discipline, tail spend optimization, integration issue resolution, and digital enablement through Coupa, Oracle, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories and route demand through the right buying channel, including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and Coupa Smart Intake guided buying.
* Execute purchase transactions within defined SLAs while ensuring policy compliance, PO accuracy, and Contract\-to\-PO alignment.
* Partner with Source\-to\-Pay, category managers, Bid Desk, Finance, requesters, and suppliers to support buying strategy execution and resolve L1/L2 procurement queries.
* Manage PO lifecycle activities, including requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, issue triage, and PO hygiene to support audit readiness and reliable reporting.
* Drive spend analytics, including tail spend, buying channel, supplier, category, PO, receipt, and spend cube analysis to identify consolidation, compliance, and optimization opportunities.
* Monitor Coupa–Oracle integration issues, including inactive supplier sites, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt discrepancies, and coordinate resolution with relevant teams.
* Support dashboards and KPI reporting using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, Excel, and related tools to improve operational visibility and decision\-making.
* Enable AI\-led procurement transformation by leveraging Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio for intake classification, requisition routing, workflow automation, UAT/SIT support, and use\-case development.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline 4\-5 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred or 6\-7 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred.
* Ability to independently manage end\-to\-end buying activities across assigned categories and route purchases through appropriate buying channels.
* Strong understanding of Source\-to\-Pay, Procure\-to\-Pay, Coupa Smart Intake, catalogue buying, contract buying, spot buying, and guided buying processes.
* Proven capability in PO lifecycle management, requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, Contract\-to\-PO alignment, catalogue enablement, and PO hygiene.
* Strong analytical skills to conduct tail spend, buying channel, spend cube, PO, and receipt data analysis using Coupa, Oracle, Power BI, Excel, or similar tools.
* Ability to manage L1 and L2 procurement helpdesk queries, coordinate with Bid Desk, Finance, Source\-to\-Pay, and category teams, and escalate critical issues appropriately.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Experience supporting procurement transformation, channel management, tail spend reduction, and unmanaged spend compliance initiatives.
* Working knowledge of Coupa–Oracle integration touchpoints, including supplier site, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt\-related issue resolution.
* Comfort using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, dashboards, and reporting tools to monitor operational KPIs and support decision\-making.
* Awareness of AI\-enabled procurement capabilities, including Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio, Process Transformation with willingness to develop practical use cases and assist in Process Intelligence initiatives.
* Experience participating in UAT, SIT, pressure testing, process improvement, automation, and workflow optimization initiatives.


**Eligibility Criteria**

title: Transformation Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 The Transformation Officer is an intellectually curious, analytically driven role at the foundation of the Transformation Office. Working as a core member of a transformation program team, this individual supports the delivery of discrete workstreams by conducting structured business analysis, gathering and synthesising operational data, mapping processes, engaging with subject matter experts, and producing clear outputs that drive informed decision\-making and program progress.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for an early\-career professional with the mindset of a consultant — someone who is energised by problem\-solving, takes initiative to dig into the detail, and takes pride in producing high\-quality, rigorous work. The Transformation Officer will work closely alongside global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business, gaining broad exposure to the firm's operations and technology landscape while contributing meaningfully to real transformation outcomes from day one.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Analysis \& Research**
* Conduct structured current\-state analysis to understand existing processes, workflows, roles, and operational pain points, through interviews, workshops, and data review
* Gather, clean, and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement
* Develop and maintain process maps, data models, and analytical frameworks that underpin workstream findings and recommendations
* Analyse interdependencies between people, process, technology, and governance elements of the operating model, under the guidance of the Senior Officer or Program Lead
* Proactively research best practices, benchmarks, and comparable approaches to inform solution design
* Contribute to the development of business cases, options papers, and other analytical outputs that inform senior decision\-making


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Requirements Gathering**
* Engage day\-to\-day with global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business to gather information, validate analysis, and support the change process
* Support the facilitation of workshops and interviews with stakeholders across functions to capture requirements, surface pain points, and gather input
* Assist in translating business needs into clear, structured requirements and user stories for technology and process workstreams
* Support change impact assessments and stakeholder mapping activities
* Build constructive working relationships with subject matter experts and operational counterparts across the business
* Communicate findings and workstream updates clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, in a manner appropriate to the audience


**Technology\-Enabled Transformation**
* Support work with Global Process Owners, Tech, Product, and Operations teams to understand technology solutions and their implications for the operating model
* Contribute to the definition of functional requirements and business logic for tech\-enabled tools, workflows, and automation opportunities
* Develop an active awareness of AI and agentic AI tools and their potential to create value within transformation workstreams, in line with Alter Domus's AI governance framework
* Assist in ensuring alignment between business processes and system capabilities, flagging gaps and inconsistencies for resolution


**Workstream Support \& Delivery**
* Support the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned workstreams, taking ownership of defined tasks and deliverables within the broader program plan
* Maintain up\-to\-date workstream documentation, including process maps, trackers, issue logs, and meeting notes
* Assist with data analysis, reporting, and insights to inform program governance and decision\-making
* Participate in testing, user acceptance, and validation activities to ensure solutions meet business needs
* Identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies promptly, with an initial view on potential solutions
* Demonstrate a self\-starter attitude — proactively progressing work without waiting for direction, and consistently delivering to a high standard


**Change Management \& Documentation**
* Support the design and delivery of change activities, including communications, training materials, and readiness assessments
* Help identify change resistance and contribute to strategies that build engagement and adoption across impacted teams
* Produce clear, well\-structured documentation of current\-state and future\-state processes, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), playbooks, and knowledge assets to enable smooth transition to new ways of working
* Contribute to knowledge transfer activities and ensure workstream outputs are thoroughly recorded and accessible for BAU teams


**Essential**
**Skills \& Experience Required:**
* 3\-4 years of professional experience in management consulting, business analysis, operations, financial services, or a related analytical field; exceptional recent graduates will also be considered
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to structure problems clearly, analyse data rigorously, and draw well\-reasoned conclusions
* High attention to detail with a commitment to producing accurate, high\-quality work
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information in a structured and compelling way
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to build clean models and well\-structured presentations
* A proactive, self\-starting mindset — intellectually curious, eager to learn, and comfortable taking initiative in ambiguous situations
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* High levels of personal drive, ownership, and accountability


**Desirable**
* Domain knowledge in one or more of the following:
+ Fund Administration (e.g., NAV production, investor reporting, transfer agency, custody operations, or related middle/back\-office processes)
+ Financial Services Technology (e.g., platforms, infrastructure, system implementations, or digital transformation)
+ AI Enablement (e.g., GenAI adoption, process automation, AI\-assisted workflows, or data\-driven transformation)

* Sound understanding of how regulated financial services entities operate, with some exposure to fund administration, private equity, alternative investments, or wealth management
* Exposure to regulatory change programmes or compliance\-driven transformation
* Experience with service design, customer journey mapping, or lean/six sigma methodologies
* Prior exposure to process improvement, project delivery, or transformation activity in any context (professional or academic)
* Familiarity with process mapping or collaboration tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Confluence, Jira)
* Familiarity with project management or change management frameworks (e.g., Agile, PRINCE2, Prosci, Kotter)
* Familiarity with technology concepts such as workflow automation, system integration, APIs, and cloud\-based platforms
* Business analysis certification (e.g., BCS, IIBA/CBAP) or Agile/Scrum certification (CSM, CSPO) a plus
* Undergraduate or postgraduate degree from a leading institution, ideally in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a field with role\-relevant transferable skills


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

title: Senior Manager Finance - M&A and Divestments
description:
**Job Purpose**
 In this role you will be responsible for evaluating, structuring, and executing the financial component of complex transactions that support the company’s strategic objectives, including acquisitions, divestitures, and strategic partnerships. You will be a key business partner for the M\&A team and provide an essential bridge between the world of transaction\-related finance and internal corporate finance and other functional teams.
   

  

 The role requires a strong blend of strategic thinking, transaction experience, financial acumen, and cross\-functional collaboration to support the company’s long\-term growth agenda. This will include financial evaluations and risk assessments on M\&A and divestments, negotiation support and presentation to the corresponding governance bodies, building in\-depth knowledge of the business and work closely with all needed stakeholders (eg tax, treasury, funds flow, and supply hubs) and conduct post\-evaluation of M\&A and divestment deals.
   

  

 The incumbent will be a key business partner for the M\&A team, connecting them through a lens of financial transactions to the broader Sandoz internal finance and other teams and bridging that gap.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
* Create financial modelling, valuation, and scenario analysis for M\&A and other strategic initiatives.
* Assist in due diligence processes and preparation of financial materials for internal and external stakeholders.
* Execute the financial aspects of integration and separation planning by supporting financial workstreams and tracking synergy realization or cost impacts.
* Collaborate with Strategy, Corporate Development, and Business Unit teams to evaluate investment opportunities and strategic options.
* Prepare business cases and financial presentations for senior leadership review.
* Conduct market and competitor financial analysis to support strategic recommendations.
* Ensure compliance with financial governance and internal controls throughout project execution.
* Supports post\-deal analysis and post\-implementation reviews to assess actual vs. planned outcomes of transformation and capture lessons learned. Required BPA activities around the finances of the Transformation and Growth function.
* Ad\-hoc requests and support.


**Key Performance indicators**
* Successful completion of projects
* Realization of synergies and value creation targets such as NPV, ROIC, payback
* Transformation Initiative delivery
* Accuracy and timeliness of forecasts
* On time and on budget integration and separation after transaction completion
* Compliance of financial processes with Sandoz Financial Control Framework requirements
* Meeting internal reporting deadlines


**Minimum Requirements**
* Chartered Accountant, MBA Finance / CFA
* 8–10 years of experience in Corporate Finance, investment banking, consulting, Corporate M\&A, due diligence or a similar analytical role.
* Strong financial modelling and analytical skills with attention to detail.
* Experience supporting M\&A, transformation or strategic finance projects is preferred.
* Excellent communication and presentation (Written and Verbal) skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively across functions and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, financial analysis tools, and project tracking tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, or similar).
* Experience in life sciences, healthcare, or a similarly dynamic and regulated industry is a plus.


**Why consider Sandoz?**
 Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100\+ countries in 2025 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
   

  

 With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low\-cost, high\-quality medicines, sustainably.
   

  

 Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible\-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
   

  

 Join us!
   

  

**Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

 and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Markets Business Finance \& Control (BF\&C) is a division of Global Banking \& Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for the production and independent validation of Global Markets' profit and loss and balance sheet. In this regard, BF\&C will ensure, inter alia, that accounting policies are correctly and consistently applied, and that trading portfolios are appropriately valued.
   

  

 The team prepares and reports P\&L and balance sheet to the business and ensures the accuracy and integrity of the general ledger. We are responsible for daily service delivery and ensuring effective controls, transparent management information and becoming a center of excellence delivering process simplification and efficiencies. We work closely with front office, middle office, traders and valuation control teams to drive the control agenda across the business.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 Global Markets Business Finance \& Control (BF\&C) seeks to provide a first\-class support service with particular focus on the relationship between trading risk positions and P\&L components. We are looking to recruit an individual to work in the Financial Control and Financial Management function covering the Global Commodities trading desks. The candidate’s main responsibility will be to produce and deliver the daily P\&L and Balance Sheet to front office, providing a high standard of analysis and explanation around any issues faced and daily revenue drivers. The candidate will therefore have considerable interaction with the respective Front Office, Middle Office, and Finance and Trade Capture teams so good communication and time management skills are an essential requirement for this job.
   

  

 Primary products covered will include: Futures, Forwards, Options, Swaps (Commodities Underlying)

* Contribute on the overall Commodities portfolio and deliveries.

* Front\-to\-Back analysis \& reconciliations of front office p\&l and balance sheet to firm sub\-ledgers,
* Assist with execution of month\-end controls ensuring management vs financial P\&L variances are within thresholds
* Analyze traders’ risk positions and understand and apply the Greeks (Delta, Vega Gamma) vs daily market moves.
* Liaise with various business partners such as Technology, Market Risk, Credit Risk, Operations and Finance to resolve issues / queries.
* Development \& continuous improvement of existing processes \& workflow.
* Testing / UAT for systems work ranging from minor system releases to major system implementations.
* Remediation of issues in an autonomous yet timely manner considering the principles of control and the need to mitigate operational risk.

 Qualified Chartered Accountant/CPA /CFA / MBA/ B. Tech from Tier I/II institute with at least 6 yrs. Experience in Investment Banking Valuation/ Product Control function, preferably with experience in Commodities.

* Ability to use Access or VBA would enhance the candidate’s attractiveness significantly

 5 to 6 years with at least 4 years’ experience in Global Markets Product Control role.

* Understanding of the Commodities markets and products
* Understanding of the PnL Attribution and Accounting of the Commodities products
* Global Markets experience in Finance
* Experience in dealing with pricing models, Trading systems, Ledgers and Sub\-ledgers.
* Control focused, analytical, team oriented, comfortable with complex products

* Demonstrated ability to work in a high pressure environment

title: Leveraged Finance Credit Research, Private Financing Solutions, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
**Business Overview**
 PFS Investment Partners, a part of BlackRock, is a leading global, credit\-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk\-adjusted returns for our clients. We manage various strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high yield bonds; asset\-based finance and real estate. The scale and breadth of our platform offer the flexibility to invest in companies large and small, through standard or customized solutions. At our core, we share a common thread of intellectual rigor and discipline that enables us to create value for our clients.
   

  

**Role Description**
 This is a VP position within our US Lev Fin team across industry. The candidate will work with the US Lev Fin team and work closely with the portfolio managers in assessing public, liquid credit opportunities. The ideal candidate should be capable of primary credit coverage of a defined list of issuers and will be responsible for rigorous credit\-orientated fundamental research across the corporate capital structure. The individual will be monitoring investments for Public High Yield, Leveraged Loan and Long/Short Credit strategies. Generalists could apply.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Conduct fundamental credit research across the corporate capital structure
* Work with a senior analyst in covering various sectors, analyzing and explaining economic, competitive and political drivers that impact a borrower’s credit quality.
* Contribute trade ideas and discuss them with the portfolio managers, participate in relative value and trade structuring discussions
* Interact with management teams, industry sources, other analysts, sell\-side analysts, and other investment professionals
* Assimilate and filter various sources of information to develop long term, well\-researched investment theses on credits, sectors and issuers
* Create historical and projected financial models, analyze key financial and operational metrics, develop deep valuation
* Communicate credit opinions and investment recommendations orally and in writing to Portfolio Managers, other analysts, credit and advisory committees and external clients


**Skills, Experience And Education**
* 7\-11 years of experience in credit/financial statement analysis, with specific experience analyzing companies, fixed income securities and equity investments
* Relevant experience in credit research (sector agnostic)
* MBA or equivalent qualification in Finance with superior academic record; CFA will be an added advantage
* Advanced financial analysis and modelling skills with specific experience in one of several of the following: analyzing companies, fixed income securities or equity investments
* Strong Excel, financial modelling, and analytical skills
* Familiarity and experience with bond and loan covenants – familiarity with leveraged loan credits and syndication processes in beneficial but not essential
* Enquiring and analytically minded with a logical and thorough work ethic
* Must possess the desire and ability to work in a team\-orientated environment
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

 ●       
 
 Prepare and process bank payments for salaries, vendors and contractors, including CMS/bulk payment uploads and beneficiary verification.
 




 ●       
 
 Perform regular bank reconciliations and follow up internally for pending approvals and invoices.
 




 ●       
 
 Prepare and file GST returns (GSTR\-1 and GSTR\-3B), reconcile GSTR\-2A/2B with the purchase register, and support GST payments and related entries.
 




 ●       
 
 Handle TDS working, deduction, payment and return filing, including 24Q and 26Q.

 Maintain petty cash records, approved vouchers and daily cash reconciliation.

 Reconcile receivables/outstandings for online channels (marketplaces/D2C) and offline business (distributors/B2B), and maintain ageing trackers.

 Post regular accounting entries in Tally, including cash, bank, purchase, sales and general ledger entries.
 




 ●

 ●       
 
 Maintain proper filing of invoices, vouchers and supporting documents so records are complete and audit\-ready.

 Prepare reconciliations, schedules and supporting documents for statutory audits.
 




 ●       
 
 Support new platform/vendor onboarding, including banking/CMS and portal\-related setup.

 Maintain vendor master data and create/update ledgers in Tally.
 




 ●       
 
 Support treasury\-related entries and investment follow\-ups.
 




 ●       
 
 Support payroll full\-and\-final reconciliation.
 




 ●       
 
 Identify unusual deductions, recurring mismatches or cost variations and highlight them to the Finance Lead for timely action.
 




  





  





**Qualification \& Experience** 




  





 ●       
 
 Commerce graduate with 2–4 years of relevant experience in Finance \& Accounts.
 




 ●       
 
 Hands\-on experience in GST and TDS working, filing and payments.

 Experience with corporate banking/CMS portals and bulk payment uploads.

 Good working knowledge of Tally and Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIF and Pivot Tables.

 Experience in an online/B2C, marketplace or D2C business will be an advantage.

 Strong reconciliation and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate mismatches.

 Good attention to detail and disciplined documentation practices.

title: Corporate Trainer
description:
**Job Opportunity \| Financial Modelling Trainer – Real Estate Project Finance**




  





 We are looking for an experienced
 **Financial Modelling Trainer** 
 to design and deliver a customised financial modelling program for a
 **real estate financing company** 
 .
 



 The role will involve training finance professionals who evaluate real estate projects from
 **funding, credit and investment perspectives** 
 . The training needs to be highly practical and transaction\-oriented, rather than a generic Excel or financial modelling program.
 



  





**Engagement:**




**Role:** 
 Financial Modelling Trainer / SME
 



**Domain:** 
 Real Estate Finance / Project Finance
 



**Mode:** 
 Online / Offline
 



**Engagement:** 
 Corporate Training Program
 



**Location:** 
 To be discussed
 



  





**Key Areas of Training** 



* **Excel \& Financial Model Architecture:** 
 Advanced Excel, formulas, shortcuts, professional formatting, model structuring, controls and auditability.
* **Real Estate Financial Modelling:** 
 Project lifecycle, revenue and cost assumptions, construction timelines, sales, collections and project profitability.
* **Project Finance \& Funding:** 
 Sources \& uses, funding gaps, debt sizing, LTV/LTC, debt serviceability and project cash flows.
* **Sales \& Collection Modelling:** 
 Inventory, sales velocity, receivables, collection schedules and cash\-flow linkages.
* **Debt \& Structured Finance:** 
 Debt drawdowns, tranches, interest, fees, repayment structures, cash sweeps, cash trapping and lender returns.
* **Equity \& Waterfall Modelling:** 
 Capital accounts, preferred returns, profit sharing, waterfalls, investor/partner IRR and MOIC.
* **Returns \& Valuation:** 
 IRR/XIRR, NPV, DSCR, ICR, WACC, LTV, LTC, DCF and project valuation.
* **Sensitivity \& Stress Testing:** 
 Sales/collection delays, cost overruns, approval delays, higher financing costs, additional capital requirements and lender recovery analysis.
* **IC \& Credit Outputs:** 
 Converting detailed models into concise investment/credit committee outputs, dashboards and decision\-making summaries.
* **Model Review \& Controls:** 
 Reconciliations, formula checks, hardcode identification, broken links, timeline checks and model audit.
* **AI \& Automation:** 
 Practical use of AI for formula assistance, data extraction, model review, error detection, automated sensitivities and management/IC reporting.



  





**Candidate Profile** 



* **5\+ years of relevant experience** 
 in financial modelling, project finance, real estate finance, structured finance, investment banking, credit underwriting or related areas.
* Strong expertise in
 **Excel\-based financial modelling** 
 , including integrated three\-statement/project cash\-flow models.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **real estate project finance / real estate underwriting / credit analysis** 
 is strongly preferred.
* Should be comfortable modelling
 **debt structures, equity waterfalls, lender returns, XIRR, sensitivities and stress scenarios** 
 .
* Prior experience in designing and delivering
 **corporate training programs** 
 is preferred.
* Ability to develop
 **customised case studies and practical assignments** 
 based on real\-world real estate financing transactions.
* Strong understanding of
 **model review, controls, auditability and financial decision\-making** 
 .
* Exposure to
 **AI tools and automation in financial modelling** 
 will be an advantage.



  





**Training Expectations**




  





 The trainer will be expected to:
 


* Independently design the detailed curriculum and session plan based on the organisation's requirements.
* Develop practical
 **real estate financing case studies** 
 .
* Conduct hands\-on modelling sessions rather than purely conceptual lectures.
* Include model\-review exercises, assignments and assessments.
* Train participants to use models for
 **funding, credit, repayment and investment decisions** 
 .
* Provide relevant templates, models and learning resources.
* Recommend appropriate methodology, duration, batch size and delivery format.

title: Articled Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 S Y Lodha and Associates is an ICAI Certified Peer Reviewed firm of Chartered Accountants headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra, and established in 2013, with a branch office in Indore, Madhya Pradesh. The firm is led by three partners who emphasize ethical, professional, and client\-centric service delivery. It provides advisory and compliance services across International Taxation, Transfer Pricing, FEMA, Project Finance, Audit and Assurance, Direct Taxes, and Indirect Taxes. Each practice area is overseen by a partner with specialized expertise, ensuring high\-quality work and strong technical guidance. The firm serves a diverse client base including corporates, public sector undertakings, firms, societies, trusts, and individuals, offering broad exposure to various industries and assignments.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Articled Executive will support the firm’s audit, taxation, and advisory engagements under the supervision of senior team members and partners. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include assisting in statutory and tax audits, performing vouching and verification, preparing working papers, and documenting findings in line with professional standards. The role also involves supporting direct and indirect tax compliance, working on financial statements and reports, and contributing to research on taxation, FEMA, and related regulatory matters. The Articled Executive is expected to maintain accurate records, meet assignment timelines, coordinate with clients professionally, and participate in continuous learning and training initiatives. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should be registered or eligible to register as articled assistants under ICAI, pursuing CA with a strong academic foundation in accounting, audit, and taxation.
* Ability to apply accounting and auditing standards, including preparation of working papers, financial statements, and basic audit documentation.
* Interest and aptitude in direct and indirect taxation, including income tax, GST, and related compliance and reporting.
* Strong analytical and research skills for working on advisory areas such as International Taxation, Transfer Pricing, FEMA, and Project Finance.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and basic familiarity with accounting and tax software.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, professional conduct in client interactions, and ability to work collaboratively in a team.
* Attention to detail, integrity, willingness to learn, and capability to manage multiple assignments within deadlines.
* Prior internship or practical experience in a CA firm is an advantage but not mandatory.

**Job Description**
**Chocolate FP\&A Manager, India**
**Location \- Mumbai HO**
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **seasoned finance professional** 
 to serve as the
 **Finance Business Partner for our Chocolate Category** 
 . This is

 **strategic, end\-to\-end business ownership position**

 **sourcing and manufacturing** 
 to
 **marketing, sales, and P\&L delivery** 
 .
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
**Strategic Business Partnership**
* Own the end\-to\-end P\&L for the Chocolate category, driving top\-line growth and bottom\-line profitability
* Act as a trusted advisor to the Category Head and cross\-functional leadership on all financial and commercial decisions
* Co\-create the Annual Contract (AC) and Long\-Range Strategic Plan (LRP) for the Chocolate portfolio
* Lead scenario planning, business modeling, and "what\-if" analyses to evaluate new opportunities, product launches, and market expansion strategies


**Revenue \& Commercial Finance**
* Partner with Sales and Trade Marketing to design and evaluate trade spend, pricing strategies, and promotional effectiveness
* Analyze channel and customer profitability to optimize the route\-to\-market strategy

**Cost \& Supply Chain Finance**

* Evaluate make vs. buy decisions, co\-packing arrangements, and capacity investment proposals


**Innovation \& Portfolio Management**

* Assess portfolio health through SKU rationalization, margin analysis, and contribution mapping
* Build robust financial models for brand extensions, premiumization strategies, and adjacency plays


**Marketing \& Brand Investment**
* Partner with Marketing to evaluate A\&P (Advertising \& Promotion) spend effectiveness and ROI
* Ensure optimal allocation of brand investment across sub\-brands, campaigns, and media channels
* Track and report on brand P\&L performance with actionable insights


**Financial Planning, Reporting \& Controls**

* Ensure robust internal controls, compliance, and governance across all financial processes
* Drive continuous improvement in reporting quality, automation, and data\-driven decision\-making


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**

**Career Experience \& Qualifications**

* Strong experience in Category Finance is highly preferred. We are also open to candidates with diversified Business Finance experience, demonstrated through multiple stints across areas such as Commercial Finance, Supply Chain Finance, FP\&A, Marketing Finance or other business partnering roles, bringing a well\-rounded understanding of the end\-to\-end P\&L and value chain.
* Proven track record of business partnering at a category or BU level — not limited to reporting or controllership
* Deep understanding of end\-to\-end value chain economics — from raw material to shelf
* Experience in Chocolate, Confectionery, or Snacking categories is strongly preferred


 Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy

 Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth\-watering and well\-loved local and global brands such as

 chocolates,

description:
IMC is looking for an experienced Quantitative Researcher to develop trading signals and predictive models for our Options business. If you enjoy solving complex problems, working with large datasets, and building models that drive trading performance, this role could be a great fit.
   

  

 You will focus on researching and developing statistically robust signals and models to better understand and predict options market behaviour. Your work will directly inform trading strategies and have a measurable impact on performance. You will also help shape the research direction by exploring new approaches and improving existing methodologies.
   

  

 IMC has strong advantages across market access, technology, and execution, and you will work in a collaborative environment alongside traders and engineers to translate research into production.
   

  

 Your Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and test alpha signals and predictive models for Indian options markets
* Perform large\-scale data analysis to uncover patterns and trading opportunities
* Apply rigorous statistical methods to ensure robustness and reliability of results
* Build a deep understanding of market behaviour, pricing dynamics, and structural inefficiencies
* Collaborate with traders and engineers to translate research into production strategies
* Continuously improve models and identify new areas of research


**Your Skills And Experience**
* 3\+ years of experience in quantitative research in NSE/BSE, ideally within derivatives or options
* Strong foundation in probability, statistics, and quantitative modelling
* Proven track record of developing impactful trading signals or models
* Experience working with large datasets and time\-series data
* Strong programming skills in at least one language (Python preferred)
* Curious, analytical mindset with a focus on problem\-solving and innovation


**About Us**
*IMC is a research\-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real\-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.*

description:

**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 This role is in the Procurement within Source to Pay (S2P) organization in Synchrony. Source to Pay team provides centralized supplier procurement, contracting, \& ongoing management support across all Synchrony Functions delivering those products and services needed to be successful in our daily operations.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The Strategic Buyer plays a critical role in Synchrony’s procurement transformation by owning end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories within the Global Procurement Buy Desk and Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) function. The role ensures purchases are routed through the optimal buying channel—including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and guided buying through Coupa Smart Intake—while driving compliant purchasing, PO lifecycle discipline, tail spend optimization, integration issue resolution, and digital enablement through Coupa, Oracle, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories and route demand through the right buying channel, including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and Coupa Smart Intake guided buying.
* Execute purchase transactions within defined SLAs while ensuring policy compliance, PO accuracy, and Contract\-to\-PO alignment.
* Partner with Source\-to\-Pay, category managers, Bid Desk, Finance, requesters, and suppliers to support buying strategy execution and resolve L1/L2 procurement queries.
* Manage PO lifecycle activities, including requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, issue triage, and PO hygiene to support audit readiness and reliable reporting.
* Drive spend analytics, including tail spend, buying channel, supplier, category, PO, receipt, and spend cube analysis to identify consolidation, compliance, and optimization opportunities.
* Monitor Coupa–Oracle integration issues, including inactive supplier sites, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt discrepancies, and coordinate resolution with relevant teams.
* Support dashboards and KPI reporting using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, Excel, and related tools to improve operational visibility and decision\-making.
* Enable AI\-led procurement transformation by leveraging Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio for intake classification, requisition routing, workflow automation, UAT/SIT support, and use\-case development.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline 4\-5 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred or 6\-7 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred.
* Ability to independently manage end\-to\-end buying activities across assigned categories and route purchases through appropriate buying channels.
* Strong understanding of Source\-to\-Pay, Procure\-to\-Pay, Coupa Smart Intake, catalogue buying, contract buying, spot buying, and guided buying processes.
* Proven capability in PO lifecycle management, requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, Contract\-to\-PO alignment, catalogue enablement, and PO hygiene.
* Strong analytical skills to conduct tail spend, buying channel, spend cube, PO, and receipt data analysis using Coupa, Oracle, Power BI, Excel, or similar tools.
* Ability to manage L1 and L2 procurement helpdesk queries, coordinate with Bid Desk, Finance, Source\-to\-Pay, and category teams, and escalate critical issues appropriately.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Experience supporting procurement transformation, channel management, tail spend reduction, and unmanaged spend compliance initiatives.
* Working knowledge of Coupa–Oracle integration touchpoints, including supplier site, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt\-related issue resolution.
* Comfort using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, dashboards, and reporting tools to monitor operational KPIs and support decision\-making.
* Awareness of AI\-enabled procurement capabilities, including Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio, Process Transformation with willingness to develop practical use cases and assist in Process Intelligence initiatives.
* Experience participating in UAT, SIT, pressure testing, process improvement, automation, and workflow optimization initiatives.

**Description \& Requirements**
 Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock – from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news and analytics through innovative technology \- quickly and accurately. We apply problem\-solving skills to identify innovative workflow efficiencies, and we implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products and processes \- all while providing platinum customer support to our clients.
   

  

**Our Team**
 The Company Financials team provides clients with fast and accurate market\-moving data covering broker estimates, financial filings, and other critical datasets that help them assess financial performance. We use financial modeling, industry expertise, data management, and technical skills to curate key metrics and extract insights from our data. Our goal is to deliver a best\-in\-class financial analysis and modeling product while continuously expanding and enhancing our offering.
   

  

 Across Company Financials Data, we are focused on building scalable, observable, and AI\-ready data operations. This includes redesigning workflows, improving process efficiency, embedding automation, and ensuring that financial data is delivered with the quality, consistency, and timeliness our clients expect.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Company Financials Process Automation \& Data Operations team is seeking a highly motivated Senior Data Management Professional to drive operational excellence across financial data workflows. You will leverage data, automation, and process improvement expertise to optimize production, enhance quality and controls, reduce manual effort, and scale AI\-ready workflows. Partnering with Workflow, Product, Engineering, and Data Operations teams, you will deliver solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and client outcomes.
   

  

**We'll Trust You To**
* Analyze workflows and production data to identify bottlenecks, quality risks, and automation opportunities, delivering scalable improvements that enhance efficiency, quality, and consistency
* Partner with Workflow, Product, Engineering, vendors, and other stakeholders to implement workflow, automation, and operational enhancements
* Build monitoring, reporting, quality control, governance, and exception management frameworks that improve visibility, oversight, and operational resilience
* Perform root cause analysis on production issues and develop sustainable solutions that reduce recurring operational risks
* Leverage SQL, Python, ETL/ELT frameworks, GenAI tools, and automation technologies to optimize data acquisition, transformation, validation, and AI\-ready workflows
* Measure and report on operational performance, automation benefits, and process improvement outcomes
* Act as a subject matter expert and mentor, promoting operational excellence and continuous improvement across the organization


**You'll Need To Have**
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Finance, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, or a related STEM field (or equivalent experience)
* 4\+ years of experience in data operations, process improvement, workflow automation, and data governance, including data quality management, metadata management, and operational controls
* Strong technical proficiency in SQL, Python, Excel, ETL/ELT pipelines, data transformation workflows, and data visualization or workflow monitoring tools (e.g., Qlik Sense, Power BI), with knowledge of data observability, data quality monitoring, and production controls
* Experience identifying inefficiencies and delivering measurable improvements through process optimization, automation, monitoring, reporting, and operational performance frameworks
* Experience developing and maintaining production\-grade automation solutions using modern software engineering practices, including version control, testing, CI/CD, and GenAI\-enabled development tools
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive cross\-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Data teams
* Demonstrated continuous career growth within an organization
* Fluency in written and spoken English.


**We'd Love To See**
* Experience working with company financials, financial statements, broker estimates, fundamentals, or capital markets data.
* Familiarity with process improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, value stream mapping, or similar frameworks.

**Company Description** 
 The organization is seeking a qualified Chartered Accountant to support its growing finance and compliance needs. Based in Delhi, India, the company operates in a dynamic business environment and values accuracy, integrity, and accountability in its financial practices. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas that improve financial processes and support strategic decision\-making. The workplace culture promotes professional development, collaboration, and respect for diverse backgrounds. The Chartered Accountant will play a key role in strengthening the company’s financial health and regulatory compliance.

The Chartered Accountant will oversee statutory compliance, handle GST, TDS, income tax filings, and support audits by coordinating with internal and external auditors. Responsibilities include budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and providing insights to management on cost control, cash flow, and profitability. * Proficiency in accounting and ERP software, advanced MS Excel skills, and the ability to analyze and interpret financial data.

* Take complete ownership of Shopify revenue and profitability.

title: Sr Manager - Decision Intelligence
description:
**Job Description**
**About Busuu**
 Busuu is one of the world's leading language\-learning platforms, part of Chegg. We help over 100 million learners build language skills that change their lives — through apps, web, and now an AI\-first product experience. We operate across consumer (B2C) and business (B2B/enterprise) markets in over 100 countries
   

  

**About Decision Intelligence**
 Decision Intelligence (DI) is the central capability that makes the business measurable, governed, and trusted. It spans data insights and analytics across the organization, operating through three layers: analytics partners embedded in business teams, a central hub that owns standards, metrics architecture, experimentation, and governance, and a platform layer (Data Engineering) that builds the infrastructure.
   

  

 DI does not govern business decisions — it governs the standards that make those decisions trustworthy and evidence\-based. We don't build dashboards on request; we build the foundations teams build on. We work hybrid with team members across India, the UK, and the EU.
   

  

**The Role**
 You are the operational backbone of Busuu's Decision Intelligence function. As Head of Decision Intelligence, you anchor business\-wide strategic intelligence, run the hub day\-to\-day, manage and develop analytics leaders as a player\-coach, and own the methodology behind Busuu's weekly business performance reporting and monthly leadership reviews.
   

  

 You operate as a player\-coach: you lead capability work in the hub, grow direct reports across the organization, and continue to contribute hands\-on to strategic analytics work. You partner with senior analytics stakeholders on metrics architecture and strategy, with the Director on hub direction, and with business leaders on analytics\-driven narratives.
   

  

 The role is the connective tissue of the function — turning measurement into operating decisions across the business. It is also a role with a clear trajectory: the right person grows into broader strategic leadership scope over time as the function scales.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Business\-wide strategic owner — anchor cross\-functional business narrative, deep\-dives, and performance readouts. Be the credible analytics voice in leadership forums and key business meetings.
* Player\-coach for direct reports — Develop 3\-4 analytics leaders on craft, level progression, and strategic partnership capability. Balance coaching and mentorship with your own hands\-on strategic analytics contributions.
* Weekly business performance reporting — design, narrative arc, and analytical integrity of weekly business performance summaries.
* Monthly leadership review architecture — partner with senior analytics stakeholders on monthly business review structure; you own the weekly\-to\-monthly narrative connection.
* Experimentation standards — co\-build testing rigor and best practices across the organization.
* Hub operations — day\-to\-day leadership of the analytics hub as the synthesis layer that makes cross\-functional signals usable for executive decisions.
* Metrics architecture co\-ownership — co\-own metrics definition and architecture with senior analytics partners.
* Business performance deep\-dives — cross\-functional lens, working with your team on methodology and insights.
* Strategic planning and forecasting — the senior analytics voice on business strategy, OKR setting, and opportunity sizing.


**Required**
**What We Are Looking For**
* 10\+ years experience in analytics, business intelligence, strategy, or consulting at meaningful scale — ideally with hands\-on analytical depth and people leadership combined.
* Demonstrated player\-coach experience — managing 3\+ analysts or data scientists while continuing to contribute as a senior individual contributor to strategic work. Comfortable in both leadership and hands\-on analytical work.
* Strong commercial instinct — you understand how analytics maps to business outcomes (revenue, retention, lifetime value, unit economics, conversion).
* Strategic narrative skill — you translate quantitative measurement into executive\-grade communication that drives decisions, not just describes them.
* Senior stakeholder influence — comfortable operating with Directors, VPs, and General Managers. Diplomatic but direct.
* Excellent SQL and fluency with BI tooling (Tableau, Looker, Metabase, or equivalent). Working knowledge of semantic\-layer thinking (dbt, Cube, LookML, or equivalent).
* Experience designing or owning a weekly business performance reporting cadence and a monthly business review architecture.
* Comfort working in a hybrid team across time zones — explicit overlap with London and EU as a known feature of the role.


**Preferred**
* B2C subscription \+ B2B SaaS exposure — comfortable thinking about both segments and weaving them together.
* EdTech context.
* AI and transformation measurement experience.
* Prior team\-building or hiring track record — bringing in talent, growing analysts, and building team\-level capability.
* Demonstrated growth trajectory — you've taken on expanded scope as you've delivered. The function is scaling; the right person will too.
* Familiarity with analytics operating models, data\-driven decision practices, or building analytics functions in fast\-moving environments.


**Competencies Expected at this Level**
* Strategic Thinking — plans strategy for team and projects (3\-9 month horizon); anticipates issues; plans for scalability; contributes to function\-level direction.
* Communication \& Leadership — tactical day\-to\-day team communication; conflict resolution; makes sound talent decisions (hires, performance, promotions); coaches and develops with compassion; fosters collaboration; influences senior stakeholders.
* Critical Thinking — prioritizes given impact and effort; identifies and asks tough questions; coaches reports on data\-driven decision\-making.
* Accountability — drives repeatable results at team and project level; provides clear ownership; knows when to escalate; fully committed to objectives.
* Analytics Architecture and Design — coaches team on measurement design; sets architectural standards; owns system\-level measurement conversations with key stakeholders.
* Cross\-functional Pattern Recognition — drives conversation across teams on shared patterns; coaches team members to identify and surface patterns; weaves signals into coherent narrative.


**How We Work**
 Decision Intelligence is deliberately small and high\-leverage. We are pragmatic about trade\-offs, opinionated about standards, and committed to evidence over opinion. The hub is the connective layer between business teams and Executive Leadership — and as Head of Decision Intelligence, you are the connective tissue of that layer.
   

  

 The function is scaling as part of broader business evolution at Busuu. The right person in this role will grow with it — expanding scope over time as the function matures.
   

  

 We work hybrid across India, the UK, and the EU. The role is India\-based with explicit time\-zone bridging with EU/UK.

description:
**Job Title:\- Manager \- Strategic Buyer (L09\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 This role is in the Procurement within Source to Pay (S2P) organization in Synchrony. Source to Pay team provides centralized supplier procurement, contracting, \& ongoing management support across all Synchrony Functions delivering those products and services needed to be successful in our daily operations.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The Strategic Buyer plays a critical role in Synchrony’s procurement transformation by owning end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories within the Global Procurement Buy Desk and Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) function. The role ensures purchases are routed through the optimal buying channel—including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and guided buying through Coupa Smart Intake—while driving compliant purchasing, PO lifecycle discipline, tail spend optimization, integration issue resolution, and digital enablement through Coupa, Oracle, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories and route demand through the right buying channel, including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and Coupa Smart Intake guided buying.
* Execute purchase transactions within defined SLAs while ensuring policy compliance, PO accuracy, and Contract\-to\-PO alignment.
* Partner with Source\-to\-Pay, category managers, Bid Desk, Finance, requesters, and suppliers to support buying strategy execution and resolve L1/L2 procurement queries.
* Manage PO lifecycle activities, including requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, issue triage, and PO hygiene to support audit readiness and reliable reporting.
* Drive spend analytics, including tail spend, buying channel, supplier, category, PO, receipt, and spend cube analysis to identify consolidation, compliance, and optimization opportunities.
* Monitor Coupa–Oracle integration issues, including inactive supplier sites, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt discrepancies, and coordinate resolution with relevant teams.
* Support dashboards and KPI reporting using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, Excel, and related tools to improve operational visibility and decision\-making.
* Enable AI\-led procurement transformation by leveraging Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio for intake classification, requisition routing, workflow automation, UAT/SIT support, and use\-case development.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline 4\-5 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred or 6\-7 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred.
* Ability to independently manage end\-to\-end buying activities across assigned categories and route purchases through appropriate buying channels.
* Strong understanding of Source\-to\-Pay, Procure\-to\-Pay, Coupa Smart Intake, catalogue buying, contract buying, spot buying, and guided buying processes.
* Proven capability in PO lifecycle management, requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, Contract\-to\-PO alignment, catalogue enablement, and PO hygiene.
* Strong analytical skills to conduct tail spend, buying channel, spend cube, PO, and receipt data analysis using Coupa, Oracle, Power BI, Excel, or similar tools.
* Ability to manage L1 and L2 procurement helpdesk queries, coordinate with Bid Desk, Finance, Source\-to\-Pay, and category teams, and escalate critical issues appropriately.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Experience supporting procurement transformation, channel management, tail spend reduction, and unmanaged spend compliance initiatives.
* Working knowledge of Coupa–Oracle integration touchpoints, including supplier site, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt\-related issue resolution.
* Comfort using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, dashboards, and reporting tools to monitor operational KPIs and support decision\-making.
* Awareness of AI\-enabled procurement capabilities, including Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio, Process Transformation with willingness to develop practical use cases and assist in Process Intelligence initiatives.
* Experience participating in UAT, SIT, pressure testing, process improvement, automation, and workflow optimization initiatives.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline 4 \- 5 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred or in lieu of a degree 6 \-7 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred.


**Work Timings: 04:00 PM – 01:00 AM IST**
 (WORK TIMINGS: This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

title: Cost Manager
description:
Turner \& Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.
   

  





 Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy, and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.
   

  





 Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.
   

  





 We are majority\-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner \& Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.
   

  

  

  

 Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Role Overview
   

  





 We are seeking an experienced
 **Cost Manager** 
 to lead cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, and cost control activities across projects and business operations. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in project cost management, commercial controls, financial analysis, and stakeholder management, with proven experience in delivering projects within budget while maximizing value and minimizing risks.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities
   

  





 Cost Planning \& Budget Management
   

  




* Develop and manage project budgets, cost estimates, and financial forecasts.
* Establish cost control procedures, standards, and reporting frameworks.
* Monitor project expenditures and ensure alignment with approved budgets.
* Conduct cost\-benefit analyses and recommend cost optimization strategies.



 Cost Control \& Reporting
   

  




* Track actual costs against budget and forecast variances.
* Prepare periodic cost reports, dashboards, and performance metrics for senior management.
* Analyze trends, risks, and opportunities impacting project costs.
* Ensure timely identification and escalation of cost overruns and mitigation measures.



 Contract \& Commercial Management
   

  




* Review contracts, change orders, claims, and commercial implications.
* Evaluate contractor invoices, variations, and payment applications.
* Support procurement and vendor negotiations from a cost management perspective.
* Ensure compliance with contractual and financial obligations.



 Forecasting \& Risk Management
   

  




* Lead monthly forecasting and cash flow projections.
* Identify financial risks and develop mitigation plans.
* Support project teams in scenario analysis and decision\-making processes.
* Maintain contingency planning and risk adjustment mechanisms.



 Stakeholder Management
   

  




* Partner with project managers, finance teams, procurement teams, and external stakeholders.
* Present cost performance updates to leadership and clients.
* Provide commercial guidance throughout project lifecycle phases.



 Process Improvement
   

  




* Drive continuous improvements in cost management methodologies and systems.
* Implement best practices, automation tools, and reporting efficiencies.
* Mentor and guide junior cost engineers/analysts.


**Qualifications**

 Required Qualifications
   

  




* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Finance, Quantity Surveying, or a related field.
* 10–15 years of experience in Cost Management, Project Controls, Commercial Management, or related functions.
* Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and financial reporting.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale projects and complex budgets.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, ERP systems, and project management tools.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.


**Additional Information**

 Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.
   

  





 We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work\-life balance.
   

  





 Turner \& Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.
